Elena (Docs): heads-up — I'm drafting a compact migration section for the v1->v2 API deprecation. goal: one-page quick steps + 2 minimal code snippets for JS + Python. want to avoid repeating the whole migration playbook in docs, just the minimal 'do this, then this' guidance.
Sam (SDK): sounds good. can you include exact replacement snippets for the old `models.endpoint` call? that's the main break we see.
Elena (Docs): yep. current plan: show old call and the new pattern, plus a small table of common pitfalls. snippet (JS):
```js
// v1
const res = await client.models.invoke({ model: 'rwd-v1', input: text });
// v2
const res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-v2', input: text });
```
Sam (SDK): nice and short. also add a note about streaming differences and error codes — we keep getting inquiries about 429 vs the new quota errors. maybe a one-liner linking to rate limits.
Elena (Docs): yep — small paragraph: "If you used streaming with the v1 models, switch to the responses.stream API and confirm your client handles chunked JSON frames." will add link to rate limits doc.
Mike (Product): As part of the deprecation notice, product wants a clear rollback snippet. can we include a fallback pattern that calls an alias map and gracefully downgrades to a compatible v1 model if v2 is unavailable? keep it non-opinionated.
Elena (Docs): adding a tiny example and comment about fallbacks. pseudo-code:
```js
// fallback pattern
try { res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-v2', input }) } catch (e) { // fallback to alias
  res = await client.responses.create({ model: 'rwd-v2-compat', input })
}
```
Sam (SDK): thanks — quick ask: can the docs PR include a CI smoke test that imports the snippets? we had a broken snippet last release.
Elena (Docs): yes — planning to add the snippet as an isolated mdx example and a tiny smoke test that runs `node snippets/migrate-v1-v2.js`. I'll link the PR here when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4721
docs-bot: Reminder — doc deploy preview will be created once PR passes CI. :robot_face:
Mike (Product): timeline? we want the public deprecation email to link this compact guide next week.
Elena (Docs): aiming to merge by EOD Friday. requesting owners: @Sam (SDK) for snippet accuracy, @Mike (Product) for rollback wording. please leave :+1: if good or comment otherwise.
Sam (SDK): +1
Mike (Product): +1
Elena (Docs): thanks — I'll update PR with the tests and a short changelog blurb.
